Create a new KiCad project named b24 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build a PMW3360DM-T2QU optical mouse sensor breakout with a TLV74318PDBVR 1.8 V core regulator and a 1x8, 2.54 mm host header. Header pins 1-8 are GND, VIN, nCS, MISO, MOSI, SCLK, MOTION, nRESET. VIN is the external logic supply. A three-pad open solder jumper selects sensor VDDIO between VIN and regulated 1.8 V, with VDDIO on the center pad.
Use the supplied PMW3360 and regulator symbols. Include 10k reset/MISO pull-ups to VDDIO, a 39 ohm LED_P feed, VDDPIX and supply bypassing, and the optional 28k/22 nF regulator pin-4 network for alternate-regulator support. Provide VDDIO, 1.8 V and GND test pads and four unplated M3 mounting holes. Use the local through-hole 16-pin sensor footprint.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (pmw3360_pcb.kicad_sym) and footprint library (pmw3360_pcb.pretty) in lib/ under the project directory; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
